sentences.reason: LifeMem and TRIAGE retrieve reusable experience, but SWIFT conditions generation on priors rather than explicitly retrieving them.
LifeMem clusters workflows, recalls skills and trajectories, and reports reduced forgetting and improved transfer.
SWIFT distills heuristics from trajectories, but its workflow demonstrations are not described as distilled from those trajectories.
